ideas.title: Lost in the fog
ideas.critique: An island-wide weather event that changes how friends move, with Lumi gathering them at the end, is the hail/slow-time shape again. The real volumetric fog and the search-by-calling behaviour are a good twist, but the form is not new.

ideas.title: The island market
ideas.critique: An economy computed from real event counts is new to the island, and the top-hat winners and crashes are funny. As pitched it is a chalkboard and a gag, and it must change how friends behave to count as more than a panel.

ideas.title: A pocket black hole
ideas.critique: A new physical object that everything reacts to is a physics event of a kind the island already has (hail, pumpkins, bubbles), and the pop-and-rain-back ending is predictable. Real lensing in the tracer and the spiralling hats and petals make it striking and quotable.

ideas.title: Jelly you can see into
ideas.critique: This is a body and material refinement of existing creatures, like the crab makeover and the sleeping poses, with no event or gathering. The berry digesting visibly inside a body is a lovely, show-a-friend detail, and it is strong for the materials goal.

ideas.title: Air you can stir
ideas.critique: A simulated field that every motion disturbs changes how the island works as a whole, rather than adding an event. The risk is that it is invisible live unless the petals and dust carry it, and the kite and hat gags read as add-ons.

ideas.title: Red sun day
ideas.critique: A one-day weather and colour shift is an ambient world-rule layer with a sneeze gag. It is pretty and fits the light goal, but it is expected and does not change what friends do.

ideas.title: Shadow puppets
ideas.critique: Shadows as the subject and a Lumi-led group romp with a gag are the shadow posts and set-piece films again. Friends forming animals from their silhouettes on a wall, and the player carrying the lantern, is a fresh and playable use of light.

ideas.title: Tiny memories
ideas.critique: Replaying past moments is the Yesterday and Rewind shape, now as a cottage projector. The deliberately degraded and wrongly restored memory, plus friends arguing about it, is an interesting twist.

ideas.title: The night watch
ideas.critique: One friend with a spotlight at night is a nightly ritual of a kind the island already has, and the island waking up is a predictable payoff. A single light deciding what is visible is a nice rendering idea, but the idea is still one more event.

ideas.title: Breath on cold mornings
ideas.critique: A background layer that makes feelings visible as puffs is a small refinement of the creatures' bodies, with no event or payoff. It is pretty when traced with backlighting, but an expected detail.
